# Archive Snapshot Packager demo: manifest + checksums + Merkle-style root.
import hashlib,json,time
RECS=[{"id":"r1","body":"alpha"},{"id":"r2","body":"beta"}]
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
leaves=[sha(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True).encode()) for r in RECS]
root=sha("".join(sorted(leaves)).encode())
pkg={"snapshot_id":"snap-"+root[:8],"created":time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
     "records":[{"id":r["id"],"sha":l} for r,l in zip(RECS,leaves)],
     "merkle_root":root}
print(json.dumps(pkg,indent=1))
# verify one record without the full package:
r=RECS[0]; assert sha(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True).encode())==pkg["records"][0]["sha"]
print("single-record membership verified")

RECS=[{"id":"r1","body":"alpha"},{"id":"r2","body":"beta"}]
def sha(b): return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
leaves=[sha(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True).encode()) for r in RECS]
root=sha("".join(sorted(leaves)).encode())
pkg={"snapshot_id":"snap-"+root[:8],"created":time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d"),
     "records":[{"id":r["id"],"sha":l} for r,l in zip(RECS,leaves)],
     "merkle_root":root}
print(json.dumps(pkg,indent=1))
# verify one record without the full package:
r=RECS[0]; assert sha(json.dumps(r,sort_keys=True).encode())==pkg["records"][0]["sha"]
print("single-record membership verified")
